diagnosis: The custom profile route extends FastAPI-Users by accepting an id parameter in the path and updating the user model via user_manager.update. It fails to check whether current_user.id equals the target id or whether current_user is a superuser, allowing any authenticated user to modify another user's telephone number, department, or security profile attributes.
